Hearing voices that tell you to do things you don't want to do can be incredibly frightening and overwhelming. Please know that you are not alone, and this is a symptom that medical professionals are highly trained to help you manage. Because these voices are distressing and commanding you to do things against your will, it is very important to get support right away to keep yourself safe. 

Please reach out to a healthcare professional, go to the nearest emergency room, or contact a crisis line immediately. If you are in the US or Canada, you can call or text 988 to reach the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, or call 911 if you feel you are in immediate danger. A doctor or mental health professional can work with you to find the right treatment to quiet these voices and help you feel in control again. You deserve to feel safe and at peace.
